messages:
mira: Opening a follow-up thread for the TLS handshake regression observed during the cross-region failover on 2026-03-18. Postmortem doc is being drafted; use this thread for action owners, timelines, and recurrence checks. Please state owners and firm ETAs for the three remediation items in the PM action list.

raj: I can own the load-balancer routing patch (reorder SNI fallback and connection routing). Draft PR ready, needs CI + canary. ETA: 2026-03-26. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/452

carmen: I'll own the runbook + canary automation changes (add tls-handshake smoke step and automatic rollback threshold). Target: 2026-03-29. I'll open the runbook PR and a canary job for staging.

sam: I'll take DNS TTL/egress probe tuning and alerting for retry storms. Plan: lower aggressive re-resolve TTL from 60s->30s for affected LB pools, add alert when cross-region retries > 5% for 5m. ETA: 2026-03-24.

infra-bot: auto-tagged incident: recurrence:tls-handshake; added to backlog board "network-recurrences".

raj: Quick status: root cause looks like SNI fallback ordering + late conntrack entries that lengthen handshake time on region failover. Locally reproduced by simulating region OOS. Patch is a small reorder in proxy routing table:

```diff
- route_order: [primary, fallback, local]
+ route_order: [primary, local, fallback]
```

This prevents sending the handshake to a fallback IP that triggers TLS renegotiation in some cases. Will add unit tests and an e2e canary.

mira: Good. Please add a short test matrix: unit + staging-canary + 1% prod canary. Post the canary gating metrics in this thread (latency, handshake failures).

carmen: Runbook items I'm adding:
- Steps to force canary rollback
- How to toggle fallback routing order (k8s config)
- Post-incident checklist for cross-region failover
I'll PR the runbook and link here. Also creating a small smoke check that calls `/health?tls=1` and verifies TLS handshake < 200ms.

sam: For DNS changes, plan is to:
1) change LB pool TTL to 30s in staging;
2) run 24h canary;
3) if stable, schedule prod change in maintenance window.
I'll also add a Grafana alert: `sum(rate(retry_count[5m])) / sum(rate(request_count[5m])) > 0.05` for >5m.

mira: We saw recurrence across 3 incidents this quarter (refs: INF-1209, INF-1334, INF-1482). Please tag any related PRs with `recurrence:tls-handshake`. Ops team: add a quick retro note about whether autoscaling bursts could be correlated.

raj: Adding the recurrence tag to PR and issue. Also creating a short benchmark script to replay the failover pattern and measure handshake error ratio.

carmen: PR opened for runbook and canary job: https://github.com/redwood/ops-docs/pull/459. Includes rollback thresholds and alert links.

sam: DNS change PR in infra repo: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/460. Includes Grafana alert dashboard link.

mira: Action items summary (please confirm if dates work):
- A1: LB routing patch (owner: raj) — ETA 2026-03-26 — add unit tests + 1% prod canary.
- A2: Runbook + canary automation (owner: carmen) — ETA 2026-03-29 — add smoke TLS check + rollback steps.
- A3: DNS TTL + alert tuning (owner: sam) — ETA 2026-03-24 — 24h staging canary then prod window.
- A4: Recurrence tracking + retro note (owner: mira) — ETA 2026-03-31 — update recurrence board and link to postmortem.

raj: Confirmed. I'll post canary metrics in #incidents when ready.

carmen: Confirmed. Will request a runbook review from SRE and ProdEng.

sam: Confirmed. Will schedule the maintenance window pending canary results.

mira: OK. Let's do a sync Wed 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). Please post status updates in this thread before EOD Tue 2026-03-23. If any owner needs to move ETA, call it out ASAP. :eyes:

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up-sync on 1937830000 posted to #incidents.

mira: thanks everyone — adding these action items to the postmortem doc and creating the JIRA for tracking (INF-1789).
